scope: Punctuation BM25 candidate full development Context Precision grid; not frozen
selection_objective: RAGAS context precision macro-average across all 15 office-language cells; Hit/MRR diagnostics are not selection objective.
normalization: Archived B normalization, unchanged. Rejected prompt candidate is not used.
stopped_query_policy: Retain all 90 records; stopped queries have no contexts. Report coverage and conditional metric denominators, never silently omit.
configuration_A: Raw citizen query, BM25 only, identical answer generator
configuration_C: Same as B except glossary injection disabled; preserve ambiguity gate and dictionary retrieval boost.
tie_break: Predeclared grid order, then K=3 before K=5 when objective exactly tied; no Hit/MRR tie-break
full_corpus_score_matrix: Reuse hash-verified unchanged dense and boost columns; recompute sparse scores with consistent punctuation tokenizer.
judge_cache_policy: Reuse parsed valid verdicts only where prompt hash matches; exclude previous modified-prompt format retries. Retain judge errors as null.
